evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep asks for moving date, availability, and next steps, but never frames the call structure as 'this will take 10–15 minutes and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on' nor waits for explicit buy-in.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep launches directly into logistics probing (storage details, move date) without ever asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathered: origin (storage unit, Richlands Hills), destination (Houston, 77037), unit size (10x15), items (couch, armchair, bedroom items), destination property type (3-bed house, driveway parking). Did not ask: floor/stories of destination, number of rooms in destination, walking distance to destination, additional rooms, or special considerations.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provided a range ($3,750 estimate with acknowledgment of traffic/additional items risk) but did not personalize it to customer's specific concerns or prep level. Framed as rough estimate tied to prior inventory, not to customer's stated move priorities.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip fee ($1,560) and overnight fee ($1,800) disclosed upfront; drive time, load time, and unload time explained. Did not mention 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, or 'not a guess' commitment framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moved to offering to send quotation without confirming estimate acceptance: 'I'm gonna send you the quotations, at least you have it with you.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No — neither 'Two Promises' guarantee was delivered, so no loop to close.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Call ends with customer saying she will shop other quotes: 'Okay, well I'm gonna check I'm gonna do some comfortable quotes and I'll give you a callback.'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Customer initiated departure: 'I'm gonna check I'm gonna do some comfortable quotes.' Rep offered to send quotation but did not ask 'Would you like our help with your move?'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirmed: moving date (Wednesday 30 Sept), destination address (7537 Meadowview, Houston 77037), destination property type (3-bed house, driveway). Did not confirm: phone number, arrival window, crew size, or crew notes about customer concerns.

top_strength: Rep successfully navigated a complex logistics scenario (two-part overnight move from storage unit with 4.5-hour drive) and explained the overnight fee and split-day reasoning clearly, helping the customer understand why the move would take two days.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Concerns) was completely skipped—jump directly into logistics probing without ever asking 'what are your biggest concerns?' This is the single highest-value section on the call; start there before diving into storage dimensions and drive times.
booking_note: Customer said 'I'm gonna check I'm gonna do some comfortable quotes and I'll give you a callback' - they explicitly deferred the decision and did not commit to booking the move on this call.
